# Slime clutch, Dash and Parkour :)
This mod aims to recreate a mcpe parkour mod I vividly remember.

## It includes the following features
- A custom Speed Block that gives you speed III when stepped on
- A custom Slime Stick that temporarily replaces a block with a slime block for 1s
  (looses durability on use, can be recharged by clicking and shrinking / killing slimes)
- A custom Dash Stick that allows you to dash in the direction you're looking at (5s cooldown)
